act AS (SELECT ev.*,
CASE WHEN ev.NextState = 'NOT ACTIVE' AND DATEDIFF(millisecond, ev.Ts, ev.NextTs) < 10000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS Fleet,
CASE WHEN ev.NextState = 'NOT ACTIVE' THEN DATEDIFF(millisecond, ev.Ts, ev.NextTs) / 1000.0 END AS DurS,
CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(second, ev.Ts, LEAD(ev.Ts, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY ev.[Source], ev.[Condition] ORDER BY ev.Ts, ev.[ID])) <= 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS Chat
FROM ev WHERE ev.[ActiveState] = 'ACTIVE' AND ev.[AckRequired] = 'ACKREQD')
SELECT act.[Source] AS Tag, act.[Condition] AS Condition, MAX(act.[Description]) AS Description, COUNT(*) AS Activations,

CASE WHEN SUM(act.Chat) > 0 AND SUM(act.Fleet) > 0 THEN 'Chattering + fleeting' WHEN SUM(act.Chat) > 0 THEN 'Chattering' ELSE 'Fleeting' END AS Class
FROM act
GROUP BY act.[Source], act.[Condition]
HAVING SUM(act.Chat) > 0 OR SUM(act.Fleet) > 0
ORDER BY SUM(act.Chat) + SUM(act.Fleet) DESC, act.[Source]

FROM w CROSS APPLY (SELECT TRY_CONVERT(datetime, NULLIF('@Day', ''), 112) AS DayStart) z),
w3 AS (SELECT p.Ds AS StartTs, p.De AS NowTs FROM p),
ep AS (SELECT t.[Source], t.[Condition], t.[TimeStamp] AS Ts, t.[ActiveState], t.[AckRequired], t.[Priority], t.[Description], k.Con AS Console,
MIN(CASE WHEN t.[ActiveState] = 'NOT ACTIVE' THEN t.[TimeStamp] END)
OVER (PARTITION BY t.[Source], t.[Condition] ORDER BY t.[TimeStamp], t.[ID] ROWS BETWEEN 1 FOLLOWING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS RetTs
FROM dbo.[_Maaden_DCS_ProcessAlarms_1] t WITH (NOLOCK) CROSS JOIN w3 w CROSS APPLY (SELECT CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(t.[Source], 2, 4) IN ('3A10','3A20','3A30','3A3A','3A3B','3A40','3A50','3A5A','3A5B','3A5C','3A5D','3A60','3A70','3A80','3A90') THEN 'Train A' WHEN SUBSTRING(t.[Source], 2, 4) IN ('3B10','3B20','3B30','3B3A','3B3B','3B40','3B50','3B5A','3B5B','3B5C','3B5D','3B60','3B70','3B80','3B90') THEN 'Train B' WHEN SUBSTRING(t.[Source], 2, 4) IN ('3C10','3C20','3C30','3C3A','3C3B','3C40','3C50','3C5A','3C5B','3C5C','3C5D','3C60','3C70','3C80','3C90') THEN 'Train C' ELSE 'Other' END AS Con) k
WHERE t.[TimeStamp] >= DATEADD(day, -31, w.StartTs) AND t.[TimeStamp] < w.NowTs AND t.[Condition] <> ''),
act AS (SELECT ep.* FROM ep WHERE ep.[ActiveState] = 'ACTIVE' AND ep.[AckRequired] = 'ACKREQD' AND ISNULL(ep.[Priority], '') <> 'Logging')
SELECT act.[Source] AS Tag, act.[Condition] AS Condition, MAX(act.[Description]) AS Description,
CONVERT(varchar(20), MIN(act.Ts), 113) AS Active_since,
CAST(DATEDIFF(minute, MIN(act.Ts), MAX(w.NowTs)) / 60.0 AS decimal(9,1)) AS Age_hours,
CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > COUNT(act.RetTs) THEN 'Active at end of day' ELSE 'Returned ' + CONVERT(varchar(20), MIN(act.RetTs), 113) END AS State
FROM act CROSS JOIN w3 w
WHERE act.Console = '@Console' AND act.Ts <= DATEADD(hour, -24, w.NowTs) AND (act.RetTs IS NULL OR act.RetTs > w.NowTs)
GROUP BY act.[Source], act.[Condition]
ORDER BY MIN(act.Ts)

w AS (SELECT NowTs, ISNULL(S1, DATEADD(day, -7, NowTs)) AS StartTs, CAST(CAST(ISNULL(S1, DATEADD(day, -7, NowTs)) AS date) AS datetime) AS D0 FROM w0),
n32 AS (SELECT TOP (32) ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) - 1 AS n FROM sys.all_objects),
days AS (SELECT n.n AS DayNo, DATEADD(day, n.n, w.D0) AS DayStart,
 CASE WHEN DATEADD(day, n.n, w.D0) < w.StartTs THEN w.StartTs ELSE DATEADD(day, n.n, w.D0) END AS Ds,
 CASE WHEN DATEADD(day, n.n + 1, w.D0) > w.NowTs THEN w.NowTs ELSE DATEADD(day, n.n + 1, w.D0) END AS De
 FROM w CROSS JOIN n32 n WHERE DATEADD(day, n.n, w.D0) < w.NowTs),
a AS (SELECT DATEDIFF(day, w.D0, t.[TimeStamp]) AS DayNo, k.Con AS Console, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM dbo.[_Maaden_DCS_ProcessAlarms_1] t WITH (NOLOCK) CROSS JOIN w CROSS APPLY (SELECT CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(t.[Source], 2, 4) IN ('3A10','3A20','3A30','3A3A','3A3B','3A40','3A50','3A5A','3A5B','3A5C','3A5D','3A60','3A70','3A80','3A90') THEN 'Train A' WHEN SUBSTRING(t.[Source], 2, 4) IN ('3B10','3B20','3B30','3B3A','3B3B','3B40','3B50','3B5A','3B5B','3B5C','3B5D','3B60','3B70','3B80','3B90') THEN 'Train B' WHEN SUBSTRING(t.[Source], 2, 4) IN ('3C10','3C20','3C30','3C3A','3C3B','3C40','3C50','3C5A','3C5B','3C5C','3C5D','3C60','3C70','3C80','3C90') THEN 'Train C' ELSE 'Other' END AS Con) k
WHERE t.[TimeStamp] >= w.StartTs AND t.[TimeStamp] < w.NowTs AND t.[Condition] <> '' AND t.[ActiveState] = 'ACTIVE' AND t.[AckRequired] = 'ACKREQD' AND ISNULL(t.[Priority], '') <> 'Logging' AND CASE WHEN t.[Priority] IN ('High', 'Medium', 'Low') THEN t.[Priority] ELSE 'Low' END = '@Priority'
GROUP BY DATEDIFF(day, w.D0, t.[TimeStamp]), k.Con)
SELECT CONVERT(varchar(6), d.DayStart, 106) AS [Day],
ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN a.Console = 'Train A' THEN a.n END), 0) AS TrainA,
ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN a.Console = 'Train B' THEN a.n END), 0) AS TrainB,
ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN a.Console = 'Train C' THEN a.n END), 0) AS TrainC,
ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN a.Console = 'Other' THEN a.n END), 0) AS Other
FROM days d LEFT JOIN a ON a.DayNo = d.DayNo
WHERE '@Priority' <> ''
GROUP BY d.DayNo, d.DayStart
ORDER BY d.DayStart
